name: trace-codex
description: Trace context delivery, result return, collaboration, review, and version-governance workflow for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Bring Trace context into Codex and return reviewable results.
interface.longDescription: Trace delivers a locked collaboration/context Skill package and user-confirmed work context into the current Codex task with verifiable receipts, returns actual Codex results to a user review boundary, and supports cognitive-source routing, candidate review, and explicit version migration.
defaultPrompt: Use $trace to show how this project is configured.
Use $trace-context to receive my current Trace context Skill package.
Use $trace-work to receive the Trace context prepared for this Codex task.
Use $trace to help me adapt collaboration to how I work.
Use $trace-review to show what Trace retained and what awaits my decision.
